hambidge:1920-diagonal.author: Jay Hambidge
hambidge:1920-diagonal.work: The Diagonal: An Illustrated Monthly Magazine Devoted to the Explanation of the Rediscovered Principles of Symmetry and Proportion in Nature and to the Application of Them to Modern Art and Design
hambidge:1920-diagonal.note: Primary public-domain serial source of Hambidge's Elements of Dynamic Symmetry lessons: sunflower phyllotaxis, root-rectangles (√1–√5), reciprocal diagonals, and whirling squares.

hambidge:1920-vase.author: Jay Hambidge
hambidge:1920-vase.note: Hambidge's foundational monograph demonstrating dynamic symmetry in classical Greek pottery, kylikes, and amphorae via root-five and whirling-square area dissection.

church:1904.author: Arthur Harry Church
church:1904.work: On the Relation of Phyllotaxis to Mechanical Laws
church:1904.note: Exhaustive botanical monograph with precision logarithmic spiral diagrams of sunflower capitula (Helianthus annuus) providing empirical data for both Thompson (Ch. XIV) and Hambidge (Lesson I).

euclid:elements.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:elements.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid:elements.locus: 3 vols., translated from the text of Heiberg with introduction and commentary by Sir Thomas L. Heath (2nd ed. rev.)
euclid:elements.note: Axiomatic source of Book I Prop. 47 (Pythagoras), Book II Def. 2 (gnomon), Book II Prop. 11 (golden cut), Book VI Prop. 30 (extreme and mean ratio), Book X Def. 2 (dynamei symmetroi), and Book XIII (regular polyhedra).

kepler:1611.author: Johannes Kepler
kepler:1611.work: Strena seu de Nive Sexangula (A New Year's Gift of Hexagonal Snow)
kepler:1611.note: Celebrated treatise linking hexagonal snow crystallization, bee's cell close-packing, the rhombic dodecahedron, and the golden ratio as a 'measure of gold'.

thompson:1917.author: D'Arcy Wentworth Thompson
thompson:1917.note: Landmark synthesis of mathematical morphology, surface tension, logarithmic spirals, Hero's gnomon, and coordinate transformations.
